title.narrative: Accelerating Sustainable and Clean Energy Access Transformation in Malawi

description.narrative: The PDO is to increase clean and sustainable energy access in Malawi.

The operation aims to scale up the proven business model and delivery approach for both grid and off-grid electrification, while introducing sustainable energy access solutions to primary schools/health centers and modern clean cooking in Malawi.
